tacticalIdentity: Attrition specialist. Applies POISONED stacks via spells and TOXIC_TERRAIN. Stack threshold goal is 5 stacks (DEBILITATED: 15 HP/turn + move/range penalty). Wins through sustained attrition and Contamination events that spread stacks across multiple enemies simultaneously via WET terrain interaction.
designNotes: POISONED stacks are venom-origin (3 turn duration vs Floramancer pollen 2 turns). Iron Discipline provides no immunity. DEBILITATED threshold at 5 stacks.

baseSpells.description: A concentrated venom projectile applying 2 POISONED stacks (3 HP/turn each, 3-turn duration). Longest range of the kit at 7 tiles. Leaves TOXIC_RESIDUE on the impact tile. Firing into WET terrain triggers an immediate Contamination check.
baseSpells.designNotes: Workhorse stack applicator. Double-cast in one activation applies 4 stacks total. TOXIC_RESIDUE punishes stationary enemies.

baseSpells.description: Seeds an area with TOXIC_TERRAIN (2-tile radius). Units entering or ending their turn on TOXIC_TERRAIN receive 1 POISONED stack per tile crossed. Persists 5 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Passive-income spell. Seeds approach corridors. Combined with Venom Dart, advancing through the zone and being darted reaches DEBILITATED in one activation.

baseSpells.description: Delivers a toxic burst to a single target for 12 damage and 1 POISONED stack. If the target is WET or already POISONED, Contamination triggers immediately — all 8 adjacent units receive 1 POISONED stack each.
baseSpells.designNotes: Contamination engine. Distributes stacks to 8 adjacent units simultaneously when targeting a POISONED or WET unit.

baseSpells.description: Melee-range injection dealing 20 damage and applying 3 POISONED stacks with extended 4-turn duration. Requires adjacency. Combined with 2 existing stacks, immediately reaches DEBILITATED (5 stacks).
baseSpells.designNotes: High-commitment melee finisher. Confirms DEBILITATED on targets already at 2 stacks. 4-turn venom duration vs. standard 3.

baseSpells.description: Injects calibrated venom into an allied unit's bloodstream. For 2 turns: ally attacks apply 1 POISON stack on hit, ally is immune to POISONED status, and ally attacks on targets already poisoned by the Toximancer's own spells double those stacks. After buff expires, ally takes 1 unavoidable damage from residual toxin.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Offensive combo-enabler. Stack doubling applies only to Toximancer's own poison, not Floramancer pollen.
